design_philosophy.vibe: Private hedge-fund analyst working exclusively for one investor.
design_philosophy.emotion: Confidence, clarity, authority, and calmness amidst market chaos.
core_principles: No complex charts by default—use sentiment rings, conviction bars, and clear typography.
Cards should be cleanly separated with subtle borders and shadows.
Buy/Sell/Hold signals must be unmistakable and distinctly colored.

layout_and_spacing.container: w-full max-w-md mx-auto min-h-screen bg-[#090A0F] text-white overflow-x-hidden relative pb-20

card.style: bg-[#12141C] border border-white/5 rounded-3xl p-5 shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.4)]
card.usage: Use for all major sections: Daily Briefing, Top Opportunities, Portfolio Health.

pill.buy: px-3 py-1 rounded-full bg-emerald-500/15 text-emerald-400 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-widest border border-emerald-500/20
pill.sell: px-3 py-1 rounded-full bg-rose-500/15 text-rose-400 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-widest border border-rose-500/20
pill.hold: px-3 py-1 rounded-full bg-amber-500/15 text-amber-400 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-widest border border-amber-500/20

bottom_nav.style: fixed bottom-0 w-full max-w-md bg-[#12141C]/90 backdrop-blur-xl border-t border-white/5 px-6 py-4 flex justify-between items-center z-50

sentiment_ring.style: relative inline-flex items-center justify-center rounded-full border-4
sentiment_ring.usage: Use to display the market sentiment score (0-100) prominently on the dashboard. Use border colors mapping to the signal colors.

images.description: Abstract glowing orb representing the AI Copilot. Use subtly in the background of the Daily Briefing or Header.

icons.style: weight='duotone' for primary actions, weight='regular' for standard lists.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the mobile-first constraint. Ensure the root container is constrained via 'max-w-md mx-auto'.
Ensure 'data-testid' attributes are present on all interactive elements (buttons, nav items, list items).
Do NOT use HTML <select> or native <input type='date'>. Use Shadcn components appropriately.
Do NOT use 'Inter' for headings. Stick to 'Cabinet Grotesk' or standard Tailwind sans with tracking-tighter if custom font isn't loaded.
Rely heavily on clear typography and distinct Pill badges for Buy/Sell/Hold. Avoid showing traditional complex stock charts like candlesticks.
Use Phosphor icons. Command to install: yarn add @phosphor-icons/react
For the Sentiment Score (0-100), display it as a prominent circular ring (or semi-circle gauge) in the Dashboard card.
